whatThisPluginAdds.text: Smart 404 turns missing-page dead ends into a short list of deterministic, site-scoped public URL suggestions.

surfaceOutcome.text: Frontend and static 404 documents keep their 404 status while similar links and nearby hierarchy are available with or without JavaScript.

developers.text: The resolver uses the shared registry, a fixed similarity threshold, safe relative URLs, and a bounded public endpoint rather than application-specific queries in Blade.

teams.text: Visitors get useful next steps without redirects, visitor tracking, AI services, or exposing unpublished content.
